firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently wrote or painted using ink starts and takes the first-player quill token.
clarifications: Players take turns clockwise from the starting player.
internalEvidence: Asmodee Canada's INK product page https://www.asmodee.ca/en/product/ink/ points to an official English PDF on its CDN for inventory BGG identity 437301. The PDF has facing-page spreads; printed page 2 is on PDF page 2 and the ©2025 Final Score Games credits on printed page 4 are on PDF page 3. Those pages were rendered and visually checked. Setup specifies the last person to write or paint with ink and the quill token; Gameplay specifies clockwise turns. Official PDF SHA-256: 0a6fdbd9ca11d087cf1b9bd7218e0185b8008df354b56d2941e9d725c061954f. Owner-authorized Codex editorial review, 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The rules give no tie-break or fallback if nobody remembers using ink or the latest occasion was shared.
